summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Rewarded Video Ad gate on FacturaFlow. All required flows passed: header 'Télécharger PDF' opens the rewarded ad dialog (no immediate download), Cancel closes the dialog without downloading, Watch triggers the 5s simulation with playing state + progress bar, granted state appears, and exactly one PDF (FAC-2026-001.pdf) is downloaded after the countdown, then the dialog auto-closes. Regression checks passed: language switcher works and sets dir=rtl for Arabic; new-invoice and print buttons render.
critical_code_review_comments: RewardedAdDialog.jsx: grantReward uses a raw setTimeout without a ref cleanup — if the user closes the dialog during the 1.1s success delay, onReward() still fires and onOpenChange(false) is called on an unmounted state. Low impact but worth guarding via a ref/AbortController.
adConfig.js: consider sourcing USE_AD_SIMULATION from an env var (e.g. REACT_APP_USE_AD_SIMULATION) so production can flip without a code change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rewarded ad simulation flow fully verified via Playwright. Download event captured filename FAC-2026-001.pdf exactly once after ~5s countdown. Dialog behavior (open/cancel/watch/granted/close) all work. Only regression items tested were language RTL, presence of new-invoice and print buttons — deeper regression (live preview edits, currency formatting, print calling window.print) was not re-tested in this iteration since iteration_1 covered them and no related code changed.
